catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
catalog.archive_scope: Selected upstream archive; external build dependencies and separately distributed datasets are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Store the complete suite in controller-owned material storage, derive family-disjoint train/validation/test views, compile in dev and run admitted binary/input/oracle bundles in target.

corpus_contract.code: Included for the built-in suite; external suites need separate resources.
corpus_contract.inputs: Mixed included and externally provided inputs.
corpus_contract.oracle: Per-program reference output or suite-specific validation; each adapter needs qualification.
corpus_contract.split_unit: Upstream application family including all forks, versions, input sizes and translated variants.

catalog.purpose: Broad C/C++/Fortran runtime workloads, regression cases and CTMark compile-time diagnostics.
qualification_gaps: External suites and inputs are not included merely because the CMake adapter exists.
Each benchmark requires a license, liveness check, input set, oracle and runtime contract.
CTMark is a compile-time diagnostic; do not double-count those same program families in the runtime aggregate.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: LLVM test-suite and CTMark

static_check_definition_revision.scope: selected_host_native_subset_only; no whole corpus, official benchmark, or Ubuntu target qualification
